assertions.assertion: Identifies the missing X-CSRF: 1 header as the root cause
assertions.rationale: It states directly that the 401s are caused by API fetch calls missing the required X-CSRF: 1 anti-forgery header.

assertions.assertion: Provides a fetch wrapper or interceptor that adds the X-CSRF: 1 header automatically
assertions.rationale: The bffFetch wrapper injects 'X-CSRF': '1' into headers for every call.

assertions.assertion: Shows 401 response handling that redirects to /bff/login
assertions.rationale: The wrapper checks response.status === 401 and sets window.location.href to /bff/login with a returnUrl.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that /bff/login and /bff/logout must be browser navigations (window.location.href), not fetch calls
assertions.rationale: A dedicated section states login/logout must be full browser navigations via window.location.href and never fetch/XHR.
